title: GOV.UK: reviewable civic procedure
summary: Make consequential, infrequent-user work explicit through reviewable facts, contextual correction and meaningful task status.
use_when: An infrequent visitor needs to inspect and correct a small set of facts before completing a resumable transaction.
avoid_when: The primary job is immersive brand storytelling or simultaneous comparison of many data records.
